answer: Each new identity must post a 40 POA bond in a lagoon pool, locked for 12 epochs, and answer a 3-round challenge. Auditors recheck 8% of answers; a failed check slashes 75% of the bond. Sybil cost is linear in N: 1,000 fakes lock 40,000 POA and expect 80 audits, losing about 30 POA each per caught fake, while one honest user locks 40 POA once. Auditors map the reputation graph as a prism, splitting accounts by funding source, and a vertex with more than 5 funded neighbors gets its bond doubled.
